title: Add CharacterChronicle registry model and store
description: Define and persist a CharacterChronicle attached to globalCharacterId, separate from CharacterSheet. Include fact/event record shapes, portability/visibility flags, source campaign/session provenance, and append/update APIs in the character registry database.
acceptance_criteria: CharacterChronicle storage lives in the registry DB keyed by globalCharacterId; chronicle records carry source campaign/session/turn provenance, portability, visibility, and category; CharacterSheet remains mechanical-only; tests cover round-trip, ordering, and validation.
notes: PR #347 updated after review: caller-supplied chronicle record ids are now trimmed/validated, with regressions for whitespace-padded custom ids and blank custom ids. Verification: npm run verify:worktree.
